source_review.notes: Checked all fourteen references. Platform-product framing was checked against the CNCF paper, and label/annotation mechanics against official Kubernetes documentation. Current tool details are retrieval-dated and qualified.

evidence: Reviewed entity/fact/source sets E,F,S, assertion tuple (e,f,v,s,r,t,q), assertion set A_e,f, resolver R_f, source time/freshness, independent inventory I, mapping m, counts N/M, coverage C, and graph G=(E,R).
Confirmed set, tuple, function, cardinality, fraction, inequality, union/bottom, and subscript notation is defined and GitHub-renderable.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation separates raw assertions, deterministic resolution, freshness, coverage mapping, and graph claims.

evidence: Executed the assertion inventory and reproduced resolved=5, stale=2, conflict=2, and unauthorized=1, totaling ten assertions.
Recomputed the worked coverage example as 9,600/12,000=0.80=80%.

numerical_recomputation.notes: Coverage arithmetic does not establish denominator completeness or mapping precision; those require independent evidence.

evidence: Verified missing subjects cannot affect a ratio whose numerator and denominator are both derived only from present catalog entities.
Verified fact freshness t-t_s<=Delta_f is distinct from processing/write time and requires source observation time.
Verified typed graph reachability implies only paths under recorded edge semantics, not readiness, traffic, ownership, or delete authority.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The denominator argument establishes necessity of independent scope evidence, not sufficiency of any chosen inventory.

evidence: Reviewed identity case/defaulting, mutable titles/paths, duplicate providers, fuzzy collisions, rename/move/merge/split/recreation, aliases, and tombstones.

Reviewed partial full snapshots, delta gaps/reordering/duplication, clock skew, poison/oversized records, slow processors, conflicts, staleness, unresolved/cyclic/high-fan-out relations, orphans, and mass deletion.

evidence: The denominator reasoning is explicitly labeled a proof sketch with its sufficiency limitation.
Coverage, precision, freshness, processing time, authority, and reachability are kept distinct.
